highlights.title: Anthropic sues Trump administration over Pentagon blacklist
highlights.description: The lawsuit says Anthropic is being harmed "irreparably" and could lose hundreds of millions of dollars.

highlights.title: Bluesky CEO Jay Graber stepping back, former WordPress parent chief Toni Schneider named interim boss
highlights.description: Bluesky was born out of Twitter by Jack Dorsey in 2019 and rose to popularity as an alternative to X after Elon Musk's acquisition.

highlights.title: Andrej Karpathy's new open source 'autoresearch' lets you run hundreds of AI experiments a night — with revolutionary implications
highlights.description: Over the weekend, Andrej Karpathy—the influential former Tesla AI lead and co-founder and former member of OpenAI who coined the term "vibe coding"— posted on X about his new open source project, autoresearch. It wasn't a finished model or a massive corporate product: it was by his own admission a simple, 630-line script made available on Github under a permissive, enterprise-friendly MIT License. But the ambition was massive: automating the scientific method with AI agents while us humans sleep

highlights.title: Elon Musk's xAI wants to build a power plant in Mississippi. Regulators plan a key meeting on Election Day
highlights.description: The NAACP has accused Mississippi regulators of rushing a meeting to approve xAI plans for a massive, methane-burning power plant in Southaven.

highlights.title: German publishers push regulators to fine Apple over App Tracking Transparency [U]
highlights.description: German media agencies and publishers are urging the country’s antitrust watchdog to reject Apple’s proposed changes to App Tracking Transparency (ATT) and impose a fine on the company. Here are the details. more…

highlights.title: Tencent, Zhipu Shares Jump on Launches of AI Agents Tapping Into OpenClaw
highlights.description: China’s enthusiasm for OpenClaw is igniting a stock rally in local technology firms moving swiftly to embrace the open-source artificial intelligence program.

highlights.title: Yann LeCun’s AMI Labs raises $1.03 billion to build world models
highlights.description: AMI Labs, the new venture cofounded by Turing Prize winner Yann LeCun after he left Meta, has raised $1.03 billion at a $3.5 billion pre-money valuation.

alsoIn.title: Yann LeCun Raises $1 Billion to Build AI That Understands the Physical World

highlights.title: Apple Now Makes About 25% of iPhones in India After China Pivot
highlights.description: Apple Inc. increased iPhone production in India by about 53% last year and now makes a quarter of its marquee devices there, reflecting the US company’s efforts to avoid tariffs on China.

alsoIn.title: Apple now makes one in four iPhones in India: report

highlights.description: Nvidia is planning to lean into the agentic AI craze and launch an open-source platform for AI agents called 'NemoClaw,' according to a report.

highlights.title: TSMC Sales Grow 30% on Sustained Global Demand for AI Hardware
highlights.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s sales rose 30% in the first two months of the year, buoyed by the robust pace of AI infrastructure construction prior to the outbreak of conflict in the Middle East.
